Lithology.LithologyDescription: Clayey Sand (SC), Reddish brown, fine grained, medium dense, moist, non-native fill.

Silty Clay (ML), Mottled, orange, tan, olive-gray, white, firm, low plasticity, moist, with increasing Calcareous nodules, streaks @ 7.5-10', with increasing Limestone gravel, coarse-fine @ 7.5-10', with increasing Clay (olive-gray) @ 10-17.5'.
Clayey Silt (CL), Light tan-white, very stiff, low moisture, with Limestone gravel, angular, coarse-fine.
Silty Sand (SM), Gray, coarse grained, moderately graded, loose, saturated.
